name: Monopoly Marvel Avengers
summary: Recruit Marvel heroes, set up S.H.I.E.L.D. bases and headquarters.

cards.av-shield-01: Report to HQ: advance to GO. Collect 200 M$.
cards.av-shield-03: Tactical reinforcement with Black Panther. If you pass GO, collect 200 M$.
cards.av-shield-04: Join Captain Marvel's squad. If you pass GO, collect 200 M$.
cards.av-shield-05: Emergency transport requisition: advance to the nearest tactical vehicle. If it is owned, pay the owner twice the rental.
cards.av-shield-06: Emergency transport requisition: advance to the nearest tactical vehicle. If it is owned, pay the owner twice the rental.
cards.av-shield-07: Technology inspection: advance to the nearest technology. Throw the dice again and pay the owner ten times the amount thrown.
cards.av-shield-08: Quinjet flight. If you pass GO, collect 200 M$.
cards.av-shield-09: Stark technology dividends: the bank pays you 50 M$.
cards.av-shield-10: Level 7 clearance: get out of The Raft free. This card may be kept until needed or sold.
cards.av-shield-11: Tactical retreat: go back three spaces.
cards.av-shield-12: Locked up in The Raft. Do not pass GO, do not collect 200 M$.
cards.av-shield-13: Weapons maintenance: pay 25 M$ per base and 100 M$ per headquarters.
cards.av-shield-14: Speeding in flight armour: pay a 15 M$ fine.
cards.av-shield-15: Emergency coalition funding: pay each player 50 M$.
cards.av-stark-01: Planetary mission launch: advance to GO. Collect 200 M$.
cards.av-stark-02: Stark patent sold: bank error in your favour, collect 200 M$.
cards.av-stark-04: Sale of Chitauri alloy: collect 50 M$.
cards.av-stark-05: Wakandan diplomatic pass: get out of The Raft free. This card may be kept until needed or sold.
cards.av-stark-06: Secretary Ross issues a warrant: go directly to The Raft, do not pass GO.
cards.av-stark-07: Stark Foundation charity gala: collect 10 M$ from every player.
cards.av-stark-09: Pym Technologies research grant: collect 100 M$.
cards.av-stark-10: Runner-up in the training tournament: collect 10 M$.
cards.av-stark-11: Debrief with Nick Fury: advance to his space. If you pass GO, collect 200 M$.
cards.av-stark-12: Collateral damage in an urban fight: pay 50 M$ in civilian repairs.
cards.av-stark-13: Bounty for capturing a Hydra sleeper agent: collect 100 M$.
cards.av-stark-14: Post-invasion reconstruction: pay 40 M$ per base and 115 M$ per headquarters.
cards.av-stark-15: Heroic civilian rescue rewarded: collect 100 M$.
cards.av-stark-16: Sokovia Accords violation: pay a 100 M$ fine.
